resources.string: Show previous and next photos and videos below the current item.
Tune loading for your device. Faster previews can trade detail for speed, while larger caches use more memory.
Resolution of grid and filmstrip previews. Full-screen photos keep their display resolution.
Upper limit for decoded images, capped at a quarter of app memory. Larger caches can speed up revisits.
Prepare the previous and next photo while viewing. Uses additional memory and decoding work.
Use reduced color precision for compatible previews. May introduce color banding.
Turn off frame decoding in grids and the filmstrip to reduce work while scrolling.
Fade images in and animate filmstrip jumps. Turn off for immediate changes.
Watch for media changes while Loam is open. Manual refresh and refresh on return remain available.
Image memory cache cleared. Your media is unchanged.
Restore deleted items or remove them permanently.
Shows accessible items in Android’s recycle bin, including items moved there by other apps. Android sets their automatic removal date.
Recovery copies are stored privately in Loam until you restore or delete them. Clearing app data or uninstalling Loam removes these copies. Restored items go to the Loam album.
Items moved here can be restored before they expire.
Stored in Loam · no automatic expiry
This cannot be undone. The original photo or video will be removed from your device.
This recovery copy will be removed from Loam and cannot be restored.
You can restore this item from Settings → Recycle bin until Android removes it automatically.
Loam saves a private recovery copy before removing the original. Android may ask for access to preserve its original metadata. Do not clear app data or uninstall Loam while you need that copy.
Couldn’t complete the action. Check media access, available storage, and the recycle bin before trying again.
The previous action was interrupted. Check your library and recycle bin before trying again.
Your local photos and videos, thoughtfully organized. No account or cloud connection required.
A preview may be unavailable while Android protects a trashed file. Restore it to view the original.
